defects.claim: Indicator dash lengths are converted using only the x scale, distorting vertical dashes under nonuniform custom fits
defects.scenario: custom fit with x scale 2 and y scale 4: a vertical dash covers twice the requested screen length while horizontal dashes are correct
defects.cause: single-axis scale used for both axes

defects.claim: Minimap pan ignores the release position because onEnd is empty and the camera updates only in onMove
defects.scenario: a committed release carries a point beyond the last move, or arrives before a queued move sample is delivered; the camera stays centered on the previous point
defects.cause: onEnd does not apply the final point
